name: Penny Pelican

features.name: Multiplier wilds
features.description: Wilds on reels 2–4 carry 2x or 3x multipliers that add up.

features.name: Bonus trigger
features.description: Three bonus symbols on reels 1, 3 and 5 start free spins.

review:
A 20-line treasure hunt with a pelican. Wilds land on reels 2, 3 and 4 with a random 2x or 3x multiplier, and when several join the same win, their multipliers add together.

Three bonus symbols on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger free spins. Light-hearted theme, but very high volatility underneath, with a 3,525x max and 95.98% RTP. Free spins about once every 177 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
